tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-17: corrected factual error — markdown previously attributed the 1978 deliberate sinking to a 'US Navy demolition team'; cross-checked against insandoutsbarbados.com and caribdiveguide.com (both independent of the original source set), which agree the sinking was carried out by the US Army Corps of Engineers using ~200 lbs of explosives from a Puerto Rico-based team. Markdown corrected and sources added.

Flagged as an unresolved location conflict in the markdown rather than silently relocating the site — recommend a coordinate review.
